import math

veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Contact method

contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create systems

# Create the ARTcar vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.SetMaxMotorVoltageRatio(0.16)
vehicle.SetStallTorque(0.3)
vehicle.SetTireRollingResistance(0.06)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))

vis.SetWindowTitle('dart')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

# PyChrono Simulation of ARTcar Vehicle on Rigid Terrain

Below is a complete PyChrono simulation script for an ARTcar vehicle on rigid terrain with Irrlicht visualization and interactive controls:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.driver as driver
import math

# =============================================================================
# Simulation parameters
# =============================================================================

# Simulation step size
step_size = 0.01

# Simulation end time
t_end = 30

# =============================================================================
# Create the simulation system and add items
# =============================================================================

# Create the Chrono::Engine physical system
sys = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
sys.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# Create the vehicle system
vehicle = veh.ARTcar()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(10)
vehicle.Initialize(sys)

# Create the terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(sys)
terrain.SetContactFrictionCoefficient(0.9)
terrain.SetContactRestitutionCoefficient(0.1)
terrain.SetContactMaterialProperties(2e7, 0.3)

patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0),
                         chrono.ChVectorD(20, 0, 0),
                         20, 20)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 20, 20)
terrain.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle("ARTcar Simulation")
vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 1.75, -5.0),  # Camera location
                   10.0)                               # Look-ahead distance
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddTypicalLogo()
vis.AddTypicalSky()
vis.AddTypicalLights(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/light_01.png"), 100, 100, 50, 50)
vis.AddTypicalLights(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/light_02.png"), -100, -100, 50, 50)
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetChassisBody())

# =============================================================================
# Create the driver system
# =============================================================================

# Create a driver system
driver = driver.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis.GetSystem())
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.04)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.04)
driver.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# =============================================================================

# Number of simulation steps between two 3D view render frames
render_steps = math.ceil(1 / (step_size * 50))

# Initialize simulation frame counter
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() and sys.GetChTime() < t_end:
    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update the vehicle state
    vehicle.SetDriverInputs(driver_inputs.m_throttle, driver_inputs.m_steering, driver_inputs.m_braking)

    # Update the vehicle system (state, visualization, etc.)
    vehicle.Update(sys.GetChTime())

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Synchronize(sys.GetChTime())
    terrain.Synchronize(sys.GetChTime())
    vis.Synchronize(sys.GetChTime(), driver_inputs)

    # Render scene
    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Advance simulation by one step
    sys.DoStepDynamics(step_size)
    step_number += 1

print("Simulation completed")
```

## Key Components Explained:

1. **Simulation Setup**:
   - Initializes a Chrono::Engine physical system with NSC (Non-Smooth Contact) solver
   - Sets gravity to -9.81 m/s² in the Y direction

2. **Vehicle Configuration**:
   - Creates an ARTcar vehicle with NSC contact method
   - Sets initial position (0, 0.5, 0) and orientation (identity quaternion)
   - Initializes with a forward velocity of 10 m/s

3. **Terrain Setup**:
   - Creates a rigid terrain with friction coefficient 0.9 and restitution 0.1
   - Adds a 20x20 meter patch with a custom texture
   - Sets contact material properties (Young's modulus and Poisson ratio)

4. **Visualization**:
   - Uses Irrlicht for 3D visualization
   - Sets up a chase camera following the vehicle
   - Adds typical environment elements (logo, sky, lights)

5. **Driver System**:
   - Creates an interactive driver system with keyboard controls
   - Configures steering, throttle, and braking sensitivities
   - Connects to the Irrlicht visualization system

6. **Simulation Loop**:
   - Runs at 50 FPS (render_steps calculated to match this)
   - Processes driver inputs and updates vehicle state
   - Synchronizes all systems (driver, terrain, visualization)
   - Advances the simulation in time steps

The simulation will run for 30 seconds (simulation time) with real-time visualization and interactive controls for steering, throttle, and braking.

vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('dart')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
